sloka: दैवम् च मानुषम् च एव कर्म ते साधु अनुष्टितम् ।वसिष्ठम् च समागम्य कुशलम् मुनिपुंगवः ॥१-१८-४७॥
transliteration: daivam ca mānuṣam ca eva karma te sādhu anuṣṭitam ।vasiṣṭham ca samāgamya kuśalam munipuṁgavaḥ ॥1-18-47॥

translations.english: All of them with gladdened hearts entered the royal palace and sat down, in accordance with their position after having been duly honoured by the king.
